obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your tenancy account

results.segment: You have an appointment about your tenancy account at Ashcombe Housing Trust on 27 December 2026. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you have any questions about this letter, our reception team will be glad to help.
Your direct debit of £115.00 will continue to be collected on the 15th of each month as before.
